refinementNotes.dispatchMechanism: Verified: Agent(subagent_type: '<agent-name>') loads .claude/agents/<name>.md as system prompt. Dispatch key = filename stem (e.g. 'architect' for architect.md). No PoC required — native Claude Code behavior confirmed by operator.
refinementNotes.javaCompatibility: No Java changes required. Adding tools/model fields to agent .md frontmatter does not require PlanAgentsAssembler updates — generator passes frontmatter through verbatim.
refinementNotes.adrNumber: To be assigned in story-0079-0007 (next available ADR number — do not pre-pin).
refinementNotes.orphanSecurityDecision: Deleting appsec-engineer or devsecops-engineer is safe: x-review-security provides compensating coverage for security review domain in the planning pipeline.
refinementNotes.smokeStrategy: Manual verification: post-migration spot-check that SKILL.md files reference subagent_type with named agent (not general-purpose). Executed during story implementation review.
